posts.subject: Dream-TTT-change-suggestion
posts.bodyHtml:
Spoiler




How do I win?
*OLD*Detective Win: When all traitors are dead.
*OLD*Innocents Win: When all the traitors are dead or when at least one innocent is alive at the end of the round.
*NEW*Innocents and detective Win: When all the traitors are dead or when at least one innocent/detective is alive at the end of the round.



General Rules (applies to everyone)

*NEW*-Count downs have to be atleast 3 seconds long.


*NEW*-Common sense is assumed

*OLD*- No RDM (Random Deathmatch/Random Killing)
*OLD* - No random damaging other players (counts as RDM)
*NEW*- No random killing/damaging


*OLD*- No Propsurfing
*OLD* - Do not charge props for other players
*NEW*-No Propsurfing or -loading.
*cancalled*- No claiming rooms or areas for oneself (You're not allowed to camp, so this rule is useless)


*OLD* - Do not camp (until the last 1:00 min of the game have begun)
*OLD*- Do not camp! (detective)
*NEW*Camping is not allowed (Innocents until the last 1:00 of the game)


*moved*- Do not call people a traitor without checking the list below



*OLD* Rules regarding names

*OLD*- Advertising other communites in your own name while playing on our servers is not allowed
*OLD*- Having identical or very similar names to other players on the server is not allowed
*OLD*- The player who had the name first is the one who is allowed to keep the name until he leaves the server
*OLD*- Having unpronouncable names (e.g. ☬♏☬ or グーグル翻訳) is not allowed
*NEW*-Your name has to be readable and pronouncable for english and german speaking players.



Traitor Rules:
*cancalled*- Do not camp!



Detective Rules:
*cancalled*- Do not kill randomly!
*cancalled- Do not camp!



*cancalled*Innocent:
*cancalled- You're NOT allowed to kill AFK players (It's random killing, so it's also useless)
*cancalled* - You're not allowed to give instructions to detectives (It's useless because no one except detectives is allowed to give commands)



Traitorous actions:
*OLD*- Actively preventing a player from entering or exiting an area by blocking the entryway.
*NEW*- Actively blocking players.


*OLD*- Shooting near a player to provoke him
*OLD*- Shooting at other players, unless for self defense.


*NEW*- Shooting at/near other players, unless for self defense.



*OLD*- Throwing frag or fire grenades around or towards other players, unless for self defense.
*NEW*-Damaging people.


Spoiler


How does TTT work?
Players are divided into three teams:
Innocents: Stay alive and do your best to assist detectives in identifying traitors and killing them.
Detectives: Identify and kill all the traitors before the timer runs out or protect at least one innocent until the timer runs out.
Traitors: Kill all the innocents and optionally the detectives.



How do I win?
Innocents and detective Win: When all the traitors are dead or when at least one innocent/detective is alive at the end of the round.
Traitors Win: When all the innocents are dead.




General Rules (applies to everyone)

*NEW*-Common sense is assumed

*NEW*-Count downs have to be atleast 3 seconds long.
- No Ghosting
*NEW*- No random killing/damaging
- No Chat/Voicespam


*NEW*-No Propsurfing or -loading.
*NEW*Camping is not allowed (Innocents until the last 1:00 of the game)
- Only commands from a detective are to be followed
- Committing traitorous actions makes you a traitor
- The instructions of admins must be followed
*moved*- Do not call people a traitor without checking the list below
- When a player is clearly killed by RDM, the guilty person needs to slay himself (“kill” in console)
- The !calladmin-command should only be used if no admins are on the server
- Before using !calladmin, always try to solve the problem on your own
*NEW* - Declaring KOS on areas of the map, weapons or skins from the !store is not allowed
*NEW*-Your name has to be readable and pronouncable for english and german speaking players.



Traitor Rules:
- Do not kill your teammates!
*NEW* - Its prohibited to reasonless reveal the roll of your traitor mates



Detective Rules:
- Detectives must know the rules
- Detectives must own a microphone and make use of it
- Repeat your commands if necessarily or count them off
- Do not abuse your power
(e.g. forcing someone to stand still or to drop the weapons without knowing their position)




Traitorous actions:
If you saw someone doing something of the following list, you are allowed to kill them:
- Shooting at/near other players, unless for self defense.
-Damaging people.
- Declaring KOS order on an innocent.
- Actively blocking players, count down
- Hiding unidentified bodies.
- Blatantly ignoring or leaving bodies unidentified.
- Actively carrying or using the M4A1-S.
- Damaging or killing players using weapons or map objects, unless for self defense
- Following a player for a considerable amount of time(atleast 10 seconds),count down.
-shooting atleast 3 or more bullets without attacking someone or destroiying probs.
- Stealing weapons from someone who threw them away in order of the detective
- Entering a T-Room

Ja, aber davor nicht, jemanden grundlos anschießen darfst du auch nicht => unnötig, es ist eine logische Schlussfolgerung aus den anderen Regeln.


Zitat von Verdia

Was soll das für 'ne Regeln sein?

Nunja, viele Argumentieren immer: Ja das steht nicht genau so in den Regeln etc. Deshalb wollte ich den "gesunden Menschenverstand" in den Regeln aufgreifen, damit in Zukunft jeder extreme Regelbesessen zufrieden gestellt wird.

Zitat von My Name is Jeff

Ja, aber davor nicht, jemanden grundlos anschießen darfst du auch nicht => unnötig, es ist eine logische Schlussfolgerung aus den anderen Regeln.

Nunja, viele Argumentieren immer: Ja das steht nicht genau so in den Regeln etc. Deshalb wollte ich den "gesunden Menschenverstand" in den Regeln aufgreifen, damit in Zukunft jeder extreme Regelbesessen zufrieden gestellt wird.

Damit widersprichst du dir selber.
Wenn du das aus den Regeln nimmst, dann werden Leute Gebieten beanspruchen und sagen dass es nicht in den Regeln steht, dass man es nicht darf. Mit grundlosen anschiessen hat das nichts am Hut.
Und warum sollte man das in die Regeln schreiben, dass man gesunden Menschenverstand braucht? Willst du auch noch aufschreiben, dass man ein funktionierendes Gehirn und Herz braucht um auf dem Server zu spielen?
Wer definiert den gesunden Menschenverstand? Wirst du dann Leute slayen, kicken und/oder bannen, weil sie deiner Meinung nach keinen gesunden Menschenverstand aufweisen?
Die Regel ist viel zu offen und lässt zu viel Spielraum für Willkür.

Zitat von My Name is Jeff

*cancalled*- No claiming rooms or areas for oneself (You're not allowed to camp, so this rule is useless)

Ich glaube, du hast bei dieser Regel grundlegend missverstanden, warum sie definiert werden muss. Ich versuche, das Ganze anhand eines Beispiels zu veranschaulichen:
Der Detektiv geht mit einem geprooften Innocent auf der Leuchtturm-Minecraftmap durch das Portal in die Hölle und callt: "Die Hölle ist nur für geproofte Innocents, wer durch das Portal kommt, wird getötet." Er claimed somit einen Bereich der Map für sich, jedoch campt er nicht, da er sich immer noch in diesem frei bewegen kann. Somit müssen wir diesen Punkt unbedingt in den Regeln vermerken.
